description: NaMnO₂ is H-Phase structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.48 Å.
